sources.title: Buffalo State CHE112: Permanganate Titrations
sources.boundedFacts: School-stock titrant, dilute sulfuric acid, precise aliquot and burette differences; permanganate self-indicating endpoint and Fe(II):permanganate ratio 5:1.

sources.title: Texas A&M: Investigation 19
sources.boundedFacts: Net ionic reaction conserves matter and charge; equivalence is stoichiometric, not a universal 1:1 ratio.

sources.title: UC Davis Chem4C: Potentiometric Titrations
sources.boundedFacts: Acidic MnO4-/Mn2+ half-reaction accepts five electrons; observed persistent excess-permanganate endpoint must be distinguished from theoretical equivalence.

sources.title: Princeton: Sodium thiosulfate standardization chemistry
sources.boundedFacts: Potassium iodate is a reference standard; add starch late rather than at high iodine content.

sources.title: Florida State CHM3120L: Redox titration introduction
sources.boundedFacts: Excess iodide solubilizes iodine as triiodide; titrate liberated iodine with thiosulfate to disappearance of starch blue.
